First, 29 weeks = 29 × 7 = 203 days.
Subtract 203 days from 2013-12-28.

2013-12-28 minus 28 days → 2013-11-30.
Remaining 203 - 28 = 175 days earlier.

From 2013-11-30, go back into earlier months:
November has 30 days, so 30 days back from Nov 30 → Nov 0 = Oct 31.
175 days left: subtract 31 days of October → Sep 30 (175-30=145 left).
September 30 days → Aug 31 (145-30=115).
August 31 days → July 31 (115-31=84).
July 31 days → June 30 (84-31=53).
June 30 days → May 31 (53-30=23).
May 31 days → April 30 (23-31 would go negative, so stop earlier.)

Better approach: 203 days before 2013-12-28.
2013 is not leap year.
Days remaining in 2013 after a date: from 2013-12-28, there are 3 days left in year (Dec 29,30,31).
203 - 3 = 200 days before 2013-01-01.
200 days before 2013-01-01 = 2012-??.
2012 is leap year (Feb 29).
